fusions.name: Hard Knock
fusions.desc: Butts the target for 14 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Cornered Flurry
fusions.desc: Flaps and kicks in a ring, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health, and its damage rises 6% for every tenth of your health already gone, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Peck Back
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Dig In
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
